appraisal_events.evidence: "C'est délicieux," répliqua sèchement Mme de Guermantes qui détestait les calembours et n'avait hasardé celui-là qu'en ayant l'air de se moquer d'elle-même.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator frames the diplomat's self-satisfied wordplay, delivered laughing aloud, as met by a cold, sarcastic reply from the duchesse, who is explicitly said to despise puns; her dry retort deflates his attempt at wit.

status_effects.explanation: His self-satisfied joke is coolly undercut by the duchesse's ironic reply, weakening his claim to wit in the exchange.
Her dry, ironic retort asserts control over the exchange and implicit superiority of taste against the diplomat's crude wordplay.

ambiguities: It is unclear from the passage alone whether Mme de Guermantes had herself earlier made the same self-mocking pun on "Saint-Loup," or is reacting only generally to puns; this affects whether her cold reply reads as irritation at an unwitting repetition of her own joke or as general distaste for wordplay.
